description: This file implements a filesystem-based storage mechanism for managing Microsoft Teams conversations, including functions for pruning, retrieving, updating, and deleting conversation references, with support for concurrency control via file locking.

methods.name: pruneToLimit
methods.description: Limits the number of conversations to MAX_CONVERSATIONS by sorting and slicing the entries.

methods.name: pruneExpired
methods.description: Removes conversations that have expired based on lastSeenAt timestamp and TTL.

methods.name: createMSTeamsConversationStoreFs
methods.description: Factory function that creates a filesystem-backed MSTeamsConversationStore with methods for managing conversations.
